profile.headline: Software Engineer 2 at Mission Technologies
profile.summary: I am a software engineer currently seeking a new role in the Baltimore area. I graduated Cum Laude from the University of Maryland, Baltimore County in May 2021  with a B.S. in Computer Science and a Mathematics minor. Following internship opportunities with Verizon Media, Yahoo, and ARSIEM, I joined Yahoo as a software engineer on the Ad Tech platform in November 2021. At Yahoo, I have gained valuable experience developing new backend features, modernizing existing services, and working in a competitive industry at scale. I have contributed to large team projects, including UI, API, and backend components. I have worked with AWS and Azure cloud services, built user-friendly interfaces using React.js and Ember.js, and developed efficient back-end services built on Java, Spring, Python, and C++.
